mathematical_contract.partition_elision: An arrangement split is removable for a subsequent offset only when consecutive fragments retain the same exact analytic carrier, traversal direction, parameter adjacency, and nonzero derivative-scale sign. The enclosing run then denotes one branch D(t)=C(t)+d*N_C(t), so composing once removes a nonexistent join without evaluating the internal algebraic point.
mathematical_contract.cusp_guard: If the derivative scale signs on the two sides differ, the internal parameter is an old cusp. Its traversal normals select different d+e or d-e source distances, so the run is not coalesced and the unsupported algebraic join remains an explicit boundary blocker.
mathematical_contract.orientation: Traversal start/end selection is reversed independently of the ascending retained parameter range. Both forward [0,a],[a,1] and reversed [a,1],[0,a] runs recover exactly [0,1] while retaining the correct traversal flag.
mathematical_contract.structural_pair_proofs: Every coordinate-disjoint or adjacent-endpoint pair skipped by the monotone unary arrangement is replayed through the complete analytic-parallel intersection solver. Coordinate-disjoint ranges retain no contact or overlap; adjacent ranges retain at most their already-seeded shared loop vertex.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 build identical exact CurveRegion2 geometry. APPROXIMATE_512 may record a terminal decision made elsewhere in arrangement regularization, but it never replaces the algebraic parameter or composed carrier with finite coordinates.
